Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished, high-fidelity desktop browser application UI concept screenshot for PiCloud, a cloud coding agent. This is a real usable product interface, not a landing page, infographic, slide deck, device mockup, or annotated wireframe. Wide landscape approximately 1600x1000. Flat front-on, edge-to-edge application, no computer hardware, no OS browser chrome, no outer decorative frame, no perspective. Excellent readable Simplified Chinese UI typography, Inter/Noto Sans aesthetic, crisp 1.5px line icons, consistent alignment, real spacing, deliberate hierarchy, mature professional software craft. Main content type about 15-16px at this canvas size. Restrained subtle borders, avoid a sea of bordered cards. Keep interface copy short; no explanatory banners, marketing slogan about PiCloud, infrastructure metrics, health counters, fake approvals, made-up product capabilities, Git diff editing or deployment buttons. Use ONLY fictional demo conversation content, no private user identity, URLs or credentials.

Functional content shared across concepts: small π symbol and 'PiCloud' wordmark. Session '城市骑行'. Existing project/workspace chip '骑行工作区'. Navigation contains '+ 新对话', '开发资源', 'Skills', recent sessions '城市骑行', '文档站重构', 'API 单测'. Children are normally collapsed in sidebar. History access and search are compact header controls, long conversation is not a permanently open second sidebar. Main user message: '把首页做得更轻盈，并适配手机。' Assistant preamble: '我会调整布局和字号，再检查移动端。' One concise collapsed completed tool group with chevron: '已完成 3 项操作', secondary tiny labels 'read · edit · bash'. Assistant body: '桌面版已更新。' followed by two short lines '更轻的布局与留白' and '更清晰的路线卡片'. One normal inline text link '打开骑行网站 ↗'. Under this answer, align tiny copy and fork actions on one baseline: '复制' '从这里分叉' '⋯'. One compact active child row '移动端检查 · 进行中' with small '查看', no expanded logs. Show a tiny low-key ongoing task status where natural, not a large alert.
At the bottom, a single thin queued-message strip attached above the composer: heading '待发 1', message '再加一个深色主题', one small '引导' button, overflow '⋯'. It is a queue of one message, not a chat bubble. Composer contains the draft '按钮的圆角再小一点'; its bottom edge has plus attachment icon, compact 'GPT-6.1 Sol' and 'Ultra' selection, '排队' dropdown, one tasteful circular send up-arrow at right. No 'sent' claim for this draft. No long helper paragraphs. User avatar labelled '个人空间'. No duplicated preview result cards. Important: do not add text annotations outside of the product UI.
DESIGN A — Quiet Chat. Make this a BEAUTIFUL LIGHT, reading-first layout with warm ivory main canvas (#FAF9F6), slightly darker warm-neutral left sidebar (#F1F0EC), near-black typography, muted sage-green accent (#4E6A59). Feels calm, precise and warm like an excellent editorial productivity app. Two columns only: 236px left session sidebar, rest spacious conversation region. Header 64px high with conversation title on left, a subtle workspace chip near it, only search, history and overflow on right. Center the reading column with maximum width ~750px, ample but purposeful whitespace. No right pane open. Small green active nav marker; understated simple π mark. Compact session rows at 38px height, elegant font-weight variation, no huge account card. User message is a subtle warm gray pill aligned right. Assistant text is directly on canvas, comfortable line height and strong typography. Tool summary and child status are integrated hairline rows, not multiple floating cards. The queue and rounded composer form one aligned unit at the bottom of the reading column, off-white surface, 16px radius, delicate shadow only here. Keep content vertically balanced and enough of conversation visible, no giant empty central block. The result should feel finished and exceptional through typography, spacing and restraint, not embellishment.

DESIGN B — Dark Workbench. A refined dark developer workspace with charcoal (#151619) canvas, deeper #101114 navigation, subtly raised #1C1D22 surfaces, readable warm-white text, cool gray secondary text, and a restrained lavender (#A397EF) accent. Right inspector is OPEN and visually separated with a thin divider. At its top: '工作区', tabs '文件' '终端' '预览'; '文件' active. Within this inspector a slim project file tree of 'src', 'components', 'Home.tsx', 'styles.css', and 'package.json', with 'Home.tsx' selected. Preserve the central chat, completed tool summary, running mobile-check child, one queued message and draft composer exactly as described. Header includes a compact workspace toggle and overflow, not a dense management toolbar. Dark lavender active selection and polished slender icons. Result resembles a premium tool for long coding sessions with controlled density, not a full overloaded IDE.

A compact top bar has 'PiCloud', active session '城市骑行' and workspace dropdown. A left conversation panel about 470px wide occupies the full height below header, and a large right live application preview about 1020px wide is the main canvas. This is a proposed preview arrangement, so show an ordinary embedded app frame only, no visual editing, deployment, drag handles, AI design overlays, or publishing controls. Right pane top toolbar: tabs '预览' '文件' '终端' with preview selected; subtle desktop/mobile device icons and reload/open-external icons.
